collection.title: Toyota Alphard 2008 to 2014 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Toyota Alphard 2008 - 2014 requires a 28" wiper blade the drivers side and a 14" wiper blade on the passengers side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
